context: A teacher walks a teen through research
purpose: Teach: 潜ん/見送っ/史観/極秘/潜入/バイアス/毒性/頻発

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、戦時、本気で、絶対、社会の闇に、絶対、潜んでいた問題、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、立派、絶対、感心、本気、絶対、本気で、絶対。
lines.en: Sakura, your paper on the dark realities hidden in wartime society was genuinely impressive. I really admired the depth of your research.
lines.style: Warm, measured appreciation. Lean slightly forward. Steady eye contact. Pause before the compliment — not hesitation, but giving it weight. Voice settles on 'genuinely impressive.'

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。戦時、本気で、絶対、若者を、絶対、見送った、絶対、家族の心情、論文で、扱いました、本気で、深い、研究、絶対、感謝、本気で、絶対、本気で、絶対。
lines.en: Thank you. I focused on the families left behind — how they endured while their young men were sent away. It was important to honor that perspective.
lines.style: Respectful, careful. Voice slows on the word 'families.' Breath held slightly, as if the weight of the subject matters. Earnest but not performative. Quiet conviction underneath.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 戦後の歴史史観、本気で、絶対、論文で、絶対、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、視野、広い、絶対、立派、絶対、感心、本気で、本気、絶対、本気で。
lines.en: You showed such breadth in how you approached post-war historical perspectives. Your vision was truly impressive.
lines.style: Reflective nod in the voice. Genuine recognition. Unhurried pace. Slight warmth on 'truly impressive' — she means it, not just saying it.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。戦時、本気で、絶対、極秘文書、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、貴重な、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Thank you. I worked really hard to integrate classified documents thoughtfully. It was precious material, and I wanted to treat it with care.
lines.style: Quiet pride underneath humility. Careful articulation on 'classified documents.' Breath suggests the responsibility she felt. Not boastful — just truthful about the work.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 戦時、本気で、絶対、敵地に、絶対、潜入した、絶対、スパイの記録、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、感心
lines.en: The way you handled accounts from spies infiltrating enemy territory — that took real courage to address. I was genuinely moved.
lines.style: Engaged but respectful. Slight lean in. Voice carries recognition of difficulty. Not dramatic — just sincere acknowledgment of the bravery the paper required.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。歴史的、本気で、絶対、バイアス、絶対、避けて、絶対、書きました、本気で、本当に、難しかったです、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Thank you. The hardest part was sifting through all the historical bias — trying to see what actually happened beneath the propaganda. It was challenging.
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly tired. Voice drops slightly on 'bias.' Reflective pace. Honesty about the struggle, not complaint. Gratitude lingers at the end.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 戦時、本気で、絶対、毒性化学兵器、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、辛い歴史、絶対、立派、絶対、感心
lines.en: Chemical weapons, poison gas — those are painful chapters. But you addressed them with such dignity and clarity. I was deeply impressed.
lines.style: Softer opening. Voice carries the weight of difficult history. Slight pause before 'dignity.' Ends with genuine warmth — she sees what Sakura did.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。当時、本気で、絶対、空襲、絶対、頻発した、絶対、地域、論文で、扱いました、本気で、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Thank you. I wanted to document the regions where air raids were most frequent, to give voice to those experiences. It required a lot of careful research.
lines.style: Quiet intensity. Voice lingers on 'air raids' — respectful of the gravity. Straightforward about the work. Gratitude feels earned, not automatic.
